Typography

round(15 x 1.2^n): 13, 15, 18, 22, 26, 31, 37px. Weights body 400, label 500, heading 650.

headline.lg 37/48 650Page and section titles.
headline.md 31/40 650Page and section titles.
headline.sm 26/36 650Page and section titles.
title.lg 22/32 650Card, panel and group titles.
numeric.lg 22/32 650Key numbers: balances, KPIs.
body.lg 18/24 400Long-form reading, onboarding copy.
title.md 18/24 650Card, panel and group titles.
body.md 15/24 400Default UI text: forms, tables, descriptions.
label.lg 15/24 500Button and control labels.
code.md 15/24 400Code blocks, token names.
title.sm 15/24 650Table headers, field-group titles.
numeric.md 15/24 400Amounts and table figures: tabular digits line up in columns; right-align numeric columns.
body.sm 13/20 400Helper text, timestamps, captions.
label.sm 13/20 500Overlines in capitals with wide tracking (DC-L02-18).
label.md 13/20 500Small control labels, badges, dense tabs.
code.sm 13/20 400Inline values, dense code rows.
